name: Εθνικό μονοπάτι O2
description_md:
The national waymarked hiking route O2 spans 174.6 km across GR. This hard route requires about 65 hours to complete according to the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The path features 6956 m of ascent and 9289 m of descent. It is signposted as O2 and belongs to the national waymarked hiking network. The route passes the broader region of Mount Olympus within 100 m, Mount Olympus (Litochoro) within 1100 m, and Mytikas within 1200 m.
